title: Development of AlN-loaded PET separators from waste water bottle plastics with superior thermal characteristics for next-generation lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5452-5461
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06478J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alpha Chi Him Tsang, Marco Yu Lam Wong, Chi-Wing Tsang, Dawson Wai-Shun Suen, Xiao-Ying Lu
A thermally stable, excellent performance lithium-ion battery separator of AlN-modified PET was produced via electrospinning technology. PET was derived from waste water bottles.
